item.description:
New Features

  • Animated album art support on media views and lock screen expanded art
  • Spotify repeat-one/like/explicit-tag support
  • Spotify and Apple Podcast speed control support
  • Reworked compact mode open animation
  • UI mode (compact/normal) screen and liquid glass buttons to onboarding
  • Daily compact calendar view
  • Optional event indicators to compact calendar month grid
  • Added master toggle for mini-widgets
  • Added support for Dolby Atmos and Lossless badges for Apple Music (currently dormant, as the functionality requires a paid Apple Developer account)
  • In-ear AirPod detection for Bluetooth lock screen mini-widget
  • 'Hide media title extras' toggle in settings

Fixes

  • Fixed lock screen liquid glass always rendering frosted and inactive instead of tracking system clarity setting (Clear/Tinted)
  • Fixed system permission requests not triggering during onboarding
  • Added bluetooth, airdrop, and live waveform screens to onboarding
  • Fixed hover tooltip being clipped by row containers
  • Fixed stuck glass key-hold, redundant calendar fetches on open/close, and per-frame debug print
  • Waveform adjustments to further match iOS
  • Made shuffle/repeat haptic only fire on the button's own tap
  • Fixed update popup HTML code leak
  • Updated the HUD permission strings to show "Device Control and Data Access" on macOS 27+
  • Fixed missing menu icons on macOS 27 with rebuilt status/menu bar and notch context menus
  • Battery HUD adjustments
  • Added smooth animation to media progress bar
  • Lock screen widgets and expanded art background adjustments and fixes to further match iOS
  • Updated media controls slot customiser
  • Added track change blur transition to media marquees and sneak peek
  • Updated no media playing state UI
  • Added hide in fullscreen, mission control, and source app toggles
  • Made expanded HUDs dismissable
  • Compact mode settings gating adjustments
  • Media control button adjustments
  • Added search entry in settings for media controls layout preview

id="-knotch-v181"> Knotch v1.8.1

New Features

  • Added file drop to compact mode

Fixes

  • Fixed compact calendar not showing as many events as possible
  • Fixed audio output button being disabled in normal UI mode
  • Forced notch to close on screen lock
  • Fixed system HUD hover clipping issue
  • Fixed 6-row compact calendar months being clipped
  • Compact calendar and battery mini-widget adjustments
  • Reworked update popup UI
  • Fixed closed notch activities causing the focused app to lose focus
  • Gesture reactivity (swipe to open/close/cycle views) no longer triggers from clicking and dragging with the cursor - only trackpad swipes trigger it now
  • Capped the battery mini-widget's "time left" estimate to prevent it occasionally showing an absurdly high number of hours

✨ New Features

  • Revamped closed-notch HUD and live-activity transitions with unified collapse-expand choreography
  • Added lock screen mini-widgets
  • Added sneak peek duration slider
  • Added compact calendar all-day events toggle
  • Added pull down gesture reactivity to compact mode
  • Added option to disable app icon on album art
  • Added info popup for macOS 26+ menu bar icon toggle that redirects to System Settings
  • Added blur and flash to album art flip transition
  • Compact mode media player title is now tappable to open the media source app

🔧 Fixes

  • Moved notch appearance settings to Appearance tab
  • Fixed cpu/memory usage across notch, timers, and settings
  • Fixed debug session OOM kill from CGEvent tap leak + unbounded thumbnail cache
  • Fixed the notch open/close drift & ghosting bug + restored liquid bounce on open
  • Fixed home to tray switch revealing unmasked glass + disabled glass on solid black appearance
  • Fixed sneak peek expand animation
  • Fixed edge fade blocking text on sneak peek + fixed paused state for youtube thumbnails
  • Fixed gesture settings including horizontal gestures to skip track + fixed sneak peek resetting glass mask background
  • Fixed shuffle and repeat active indicator + fixed source media app repeat sync
  • Fixed compact calendar view snapping to media view during close
  • Fixed lock hud persisting on unlock
  • Fixed default HUD sizing
  • Fixed concave top corner + extended duration for expanded battery HUD
  • Fixed browser tabs showing app icon instead of grey note fallback for no-artwork tracks
  • Fixed macbook icon to match actual mac model
  • Fixed bluetooth expanded hud corners
  • Fixed settings window focus
  • Fixed compact mode ui opening on file drag
  • Airdrop and bluetooth HUD fixes
  • Volume and brightness hud adjustments
  • Gated liquid glass notch appearances behind macOS 26+ and improved lock screen widget styling on versions below macOS 26
  • Implemented a second potential fix for liquid glass mask lagging issue
  • Made toggles in settings respect compact mode capability + adjusted system HUD UI
  • Changed media button click reactivity to scale whole button including highlight during click, not after
  • Increased view transition blur + all-day event pill adjustments
  • Reworked 'not playing' placeholder art
  • Increased waveform size on compact view
  • Changed artist names to use .medium
  • Changed airdrop symbol
  • Removed custom visualiser
